Faithful copy of the Law Reform Commission's Revised Acts list (604 of the 606 it lists: 579 Acts of the Oireachtas, 8 pre-1922 Acts, 17 statutory instruments), with history from 2013 that starts at each act's first revision, not its enactment. That is about 29% of the 2,000+ Acts in force; the Constitution, case law and almost all statutory instruments are missing, and the record ends at 2026-10-01.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
